arxiv-1909-10460.title: Counting Phylogenetic Networks of Level 1 1 and 2 2
arxiv-1909-10460.creator: Mathilde Bouvel, Philippe Gambette, Marefatollah Mansouri
arxiv-1909-10460.description: Abstract . Phylogenetic networks generalize phylogenetic trees, and have been introduced in order to describe evolution in the case of transfer of genetic material between coexisting species. There are many classes of phylogenetic networks, which can all be modeled as families of graphs with labeled leaves.

arxiv-1912-08735.title: AirLift: A Fast and Comprehensive Technique for Remapping Alignments between Reference Genomes
arxiv-1912-08735.creator: Jeremie S. Kim 1 , Can Firtina 1 , Meryem Banu Cavlak 1 Damla Senol Cali 2 Nastaran Hajinazar 1 , 3 Mohammed Alser 1 Can Alkan 4 Onur Mutlu 1 , 2 , 4 1 ETH Zurich 2 Carnegie Mellon University 3 Simon Fraser University 4 Bilkent University
arxiv-1912-08735.description: Abstract AirLift is the first read remapping tool that enables users to quickly and comprehensively map a read set, that had been previously mapped to one reference genome, to another similar reference. Users can then quickly run a downstream analysis of read sets for each latest reference release. Compared to the state-of-the-art method for remapping reads (i.e.

arxiv-2011-13581.title: Plasma characterization and confirmation of helicon mode of IShTAR plasma source
arxiv-2011-13581.creator: Foisal B. T. Siddiki, I. Shesterikov, J.-M. Noterdaeme 1,, K. Crombé
arxiv-2011-13581.description: Abstract IShTAR (Ion cyclotron Sheath Test ARrangement) is a dedicated test facility to investigate the interaction of ICRF wave and plasma at the Max-Planck Institute for Plasma Physics in Garching, Germany. Plasma is provided by a plasma source (length= 0.1m, diameter = 0.4m) and it is responsible to create the necessary plasma environment in front of the ICRF antenna.

arxiv-2212-07857.title: Octonionic Calabi-Yau theorem.
arxiv-2212-07857.creator: Semyon Alesker, Peter V. Gordon
arxiv-2212-07857.description: Abstract On a certain class of 16-dimensional manifolds a new class of Riemannian metrics, called octonionic Kähler, is introduced and studied. It is an octonionic analogue of Kähler metrics on complex manifolds and of HKT-metrics of hypercomplex manifolds. Then for this class of metrics an octonionic version of the Monge-Ampère equation is introduced and solved under appropriate assumptions.

arxiv-2304-08463.title: Learning to Render Novel Views from Wide-Baseline Stereo Pairs
arxiv-2304-08463.creator: Yilun Du Cameron Smith Ayush Tewari Vincent Sitzmann MIT CSAIL {yilundu, camsmith, ayusht, sitzmann}@mit.edu
arxiv-2304-08463.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yilun Du Cameron Smith Ayush Tewari Vincent Sitzmann MIT CSAIL {yilundu, camsmith, ayusht, sitzmann}@mit.edu. We introduce a method for novel view synthesis given only a single wide-baseline stereo image pair. In this challenging regime, 3D scene points are regularly observed only once, requiring prior-based reconstruction of scene geometry and appearance.

arxiv-2308-09482.title: Atom-by-atom protein generation and beyond with language models
arxiv-2308-09482.creator: Daniel Flam-Shepherd, Kevin Zhu, Alán Aspuru-Guzik
arxiv-2308-09482.description: Abstract Protein language models learn powerful representations directly from sequences of amino acids. However, they are constrained to generate proteins with only the set of amino acids represented in their vocabulary. In contrast, chemical language models learn atom-level representations of smaller molecules that include every atom, bond, and ring.

arxiv-2312-05410.title: Rethinking materials simulations: Blending direct numerical simulations with neural operators
arxiv-2312-05410.creator: Vivek Oommen, Khemraj Shukla, George Em Karniadakis1-School of Engineering2-Division of Applied MathematicsBrown UniversityProvidence, RI 02912 {vivek_oommen, khemraj_shukla, george_karniadakis}@brown.edu Saaketh Desai, Rémi Dingreville Center for Integrated NanotechnologiesSandia National Laborator
arxiv-2312-05410.description: Abstract Direct numerical simulations (DNS) are accurate but computationally expensive for predicting materials evolution across timescales, due to the complexity of the underlying evolution equations, the nature of multiscale spatio-temporal interactions, and the need to reach long-time integration. We develop a new method that blends numerical solvers with neural operators to accelerate such simulations.

arxiv-2405-05619.title: Rectified Gaussian kernel multi-view k-means clustering
arxiv-2405-05619.creator: Kristina P. Sinaga
arxiv-2405-05619.description: Abstract In this paper, we show two new variants of multi-view k-means (MVKM) algorithms to address multi-view data. The general idea is to outline the distance between h -th view data points x i h x_{i}^{h} and h -th view cluster centers a k h a_{k}^{h} in a different manner of centroid-based approach.

arxiv-2407-13661.title: Optimal Strategies in Ranked Choice Voting
arxiv-2407-13661.creator: Sanyukta Deshpande, Nikhil Garg, Sheldon H. Jacobson
arxiv-2407-13661.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Sanyukta Deshpande, Nikhil Garg, Sheldon H. Jacobson. Ranked Choice Voting (RCV) and Single Transferable Voting (STV) are widely valued; but are complex to understand due to intricate per-round vote transfers. Questions like determining how far a candidate is from winning or identifying effective election strategies are computationally challenging as minor changes in voter rankings can lead to significant ripple effects– for example, lending support to a losing candidate can prevent their votes from transferring to a more competitive opponent.

arxiv-2410-01231.title: Revisiting the Index Construction of Proximity Graph-Based Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
arxiv-2410-01231.creator: Shuo Yang §, Jiadong Xie §, Yingfan Liu ∗, Jeffrey Xu Yu, Xiyue Gao, Qianru Wang, Yanguo Peng, Jiangtao Cui
arxiv-2410-01231.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Shuo Yang §, Jiadong Xie §, Yingfan Liu ∗, Jeffrey Xu Yu, Xiyue Gao, Qianru Wang, Yanguo Peng, Jiangtao Cui. Proximity graphs (PG) have gained increasing popularity as the state-of-the-art solutions to k k -approximate nearest neighbor ( k k -ANN) search on high-dimensional data, which serves as a fundamental function in various fields, e.g., retrieval-augmented generation. Although PG-based approaches have the best k k -ANN search performance, their index construction cost is superlinear to the number of points.

arxiv-2504-00397.title: Control Barrier Function Synthesis for Nonlinear Systems with Dual Relative Degree
arxiv-2504-00397.creator: Gilbert Bahati, Ryan K. Cosner, Max H. Cohen, Ryan M. Bena, Aaron D. Ames
arxiv-2504-00397.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Gilbert Bahati, Ryan K. Cosner, Max H. Cohen, Ryan M. Bena, Aaron D. Ames. Control barrier functions (CBFs) are a powerful tool for synthesizing safe control actions; however, constructing CBFs remains difficult for general nonlinear systems. In this work, we provide a constructive framework for synthesizing CBFs for systems with dual relative degree —where different inputs influence the outputs at two different orders of differentiation; this is common in systems with orientation-based actuation, such as unicycles and quadrotors.

arxiv-2508-21554.title: Comprehensive Signal Quality Evaluation of a Wearable Textile ECG Garment: A Sex-Balanced Study Thanks: This is a preprint of a manuscript submitted for publication. It has not yet been peer-reviewed, and the final version may differ. The authors acknowledge the funding by the EU TEF-Health project
arxiv-2508-21554.creator: Maximilian P. Oppelt, Tobias S. Zech, Sarah H. Lorenz, Laurenz Ottmann, Jan Steffan
arxiv-2508-21554.description: Abstract We introduce a novel wearable textile-garment featuring an innovative electrode placement aimed at minimizing noise and motion artifacts, thereby enhancing signal fidelity in Electrocardiography (ECG) recordings. We present a comprehensive, sex-balanced evaluation involving 15 healthy males and 15 healthy female participants to ensure the device’s suitability across anatomical and physiological variations.

pmc-10659998.title: Assessing the contribution of semiconductors to the sustainable development goals (SDGs) from 2017 to 2022
pmc-10659998.creator: Shuchen Hsieh, Pei-Ying Lin, I-Hui Lin, David E. Beck, Ching-Hui Lin
pmc-10659998.description: Semiconductor development is a major driving force for global economic growth. However, synchronizing it with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) set by the United Nations remains a critical challenge. To gain insight into this, we analyzed SDG-related publications on semiconductors from 2017 to 2022 using the SciVal database.

pmc-11297166.title: Development of an epigenetic clock resistant to changes in immune cell composition
pmc-11297166.creator: Alan Tomusiak, Ariel Floro, Ritesh Tiwari, Rebeccah Riley, Hiroyuki Matsui, Nicolas Andrews, Herbert G. Kasler, Eric Verdin
pmc-11297166.description: Epigenetic clocks are age predictors that use machine-learning models trained on DNA CpG methylation values to predict chronological or biological age. Increases in predicted epigenetic age relative to chronological age (epigenetic age acceleration) are connected to aging-associated pathologies, and changes in epigenetic age are linked to canonical aging hallmarks.

pmc-11482557.title: New Technology of Rumen-Protected Bypass Lysine Encapsulated in Lipid Matrix of Beeswax and Carnauba Wax and Natural Tannin Blended for Ruminant Diets
pmc-11482557.creator: Claudiney Felipe Almeida Inô, José Morais Pereira Filho, Roberto Matheus Tavares de Oliveira, Juliana Felipe Paula de Oliveira, Edson Cavalcanti da Silva Filho, Ariane Maria da Silva Santos Nascimento, Ronaldo Lopes Oliveira, Romilda Rodrigues do Nascimento, Kevily Henrique de Oliveira Soares de Luc
pmc-11482557.description: Simple SummaryUsing bypass protein in ruminants’ diets is crucial as it allows essential amino acids, like lysine, to escape rumen degradation and be absorbed in the intestine. This improves protein utilization and enhances growth, milk production, and overall animal health, leading to more efficient and sustainable livestock farming.

pmc-11569870.title: Identification of a novel ephemerovirus in a water buffalo (Bubalus bubalis [Linnaeus, 1758])
pmc-11569870.creator: Sakiho IMAI, Mai KISHIMOTO, Masayuki HORIE
pmc-11569870.description: Ephemeroviruses, belonging to the genus Ephemerovirus within the family Rhabdoviridae of the Mononegavirales, are non-segmented, negative-strand RNA viruses that infect artiodactyls and blood-sucking arthropods. Although recent advances in sequencing technology have facilitated the identification of novel ephemeroviruses, thereby expanding our understanding of this viral genus, their diversity remains elusive, as evidenced by phylogenetic gaps between currently known ephemeroviruses.

pmc-12536752.title: Comparative Study Between Extended-View Totally Extraperitoneal Rives–Stoppa Repair and Intraperitoneal Onlay Mesh Plus Repair for Ventral Abdominal Wall Hernias: A Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-12536752.creator: Kavita Sijwali, Sanjay Kala, Ramendra K Jauhari
pmc-12536752.description: IntroductionVentral hernias are among the most common abdominal wall defects encountered in surgical practice and are increasingly managed laparoscopically due to lower postoperative morbidity and faster recovery times. While the intraperitoneal onlay mesh plus (IPOM Plus) technique is widely practiced, the extended totally extraperitoneal Rives-Stoppa (e-TEP RS) approach enables extraperitoneal mesh placement and may offer improved outcomes.

pmc-13475632.title: Predictors of Intimate Partner Violence Among Reproductive Age Group Women in Mozambique
pmc-13475632.creator: Russell Kabir, Haniya Zehra Syed, Ashek Elahi Noor, Angi Mohamed, Ali Davod Parsa
pmc-13475632.description: BackgroundIntimate partner violence (IPV) is a major public health and human rights issue globally, with a particularly high burden in sub‐Saharan Africa. Despite this, evidence on the predictors of IPV in Mozambique remains limited. This study aimed to identify predictors of IPV among women of reproductive age in Mozambique using nationally representative data.

pmc-13625349.title: The impact of mHealth interventions on health-promoting behaviors in pregnant women: a randomized clinical trial
pmc-13625349.creator: Fateme Asadollahi, Samira Ebrahimzadeh Zagami, Robab Latifnejad Roudsari
pmc-13625349.description: BackgroundHealth-promoting behaviors are crucial for maternal and fetal well-being during pregnancy, yet many women face barriers to adopting these practices. Mobile health technologies offer innovative solutions by providing personalized interventions. This study evaluated the effectiveness of a comprehensive mHealth application in promoting health behaviors among pregnant women.

pmc-13682027.title: Health system readiness—the neglected catalyst in Malaria elimination
pmc-13682027.creator: Win Htike, Win Han Oo, Catherine M Bennett, Paul A Agius, Alyssa E Barry, Freya J I Fowkes
pmc-13682027.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundWhile strong political commitment and robust technical strategies are essential to drive malaria elimination, the readiness of national health systems ultimately determines whether these commitments can be successfully translated into action.Main textWithout adequate preparation, gaps in the health system can undermine the transition from malaria burden reduction to elimination policies, reduce the effectiveness of interventions, and jeopardise progress toward achieving zero local transmission of malaria.
